testing_gaps: AdminApiIntegrationTest.projectionsExposeOnlyOperationalEventAndNotificationFields does not insert event/notification fixtures or assert any returned item exists. On a fresh database both lists can be empty, so the privacy assertions would also pass after a regression to selecting sensitive columns. Seed rows containing contact/message/health-related fields, assert their operational IDs appear, and assert forbidden fields are absent from those returned rows.

The successful status/configuration tests verify audit rows and validation failures, but do not force an audit insertion failure after the business update. A focused service transaction test should induce that failure and read back the unchanged user status or setting value/version outside the failed transaction; this would protect the explicit requirement that sensitive changes cannot commit without their audit record. The current @Transactional integration-test wrapper alone would mask removal of the service transaction boundary.
